selector.rationale: The presence of scattered telangiectasias on the chest, telangiectasias with classic spider angioma morphology on chest and back, and purple angiomatous papules on the lips resembling venous lakes strongly support Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia, despite the initial presumption of Polycythemia Vera due to erythrocytosis.

rejected.label: Multiple Myeloma
rejected.why: Although IgG κ monoclonal protein levels are elevated, this finding alone does not fully explain the patient's clinical presentation of telangiectasias and erythrocytosis.

rejected.label: Hepatopulmonary Syndrome
rejected.why: There is no direct evidence provided in the vignette to support this diagnosis, such as liver disease or specific findings related to hepatopulmonary syndrome.

rejected.label: Von Hippel-Lindau Disease
rejected.why: While telangiectasias and angiomatous papules are mentioned, the specific constellation of findings and the lack of other characteristic features (e.g., retinal angiomas, cerebellar hemangioblastomas) make this diagnosis less likely than Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia.
